metaDescription: Order custom 4 x-large blankets for events or giveaways. Perfect for outdoor gatherings or cozy promotions. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When you need a blanket that offers generous coverage for outdoor events, team sidelines, or corporate giveaways, the 4 x-large size provides ample warmth and comfort. These oversized blankets can accommodate multiple people or serve as a luxurious throw for one. Options like the Park Blanket or Plaid Picnic Blanket are ideal for picnics, sports events, or camping. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery to add your logo, making them memorable promotional items that recipients will use for years.
heroAltText: Custom 4 x-large blankets with embroidered logo, perfect for outdoor events and corporate giveaways.
